description: This file defines a DeepLinks handler for an macOS application, managing deep link routing, validation, and delivery via a singleton class. It includes policies for message validation, logging, and user prompts, as well as security measures for session keys.

classes.name: DeepLinkAgentPolicy
classes.description: Contains configuration constants and validation logic for deep link messages, including maximum message lengths and error handling.

classes.name: DeepLinkHandler
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for parsing, validating, and handling deep link URLs, including user prompts and message delivery.

methods.name: validateMessageForHandle
methods.description: Validates if a message is within size limits based on unattended access policy.

methods.name: effectiveDelivery
methods.description: Determines whether to deliver a link based on policy and extracts delivery channel info.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry point for processing a URL, routing to specific handlers based on link type.

methods.name: handleAgent
methods.description: Handles agent-type deep links, including validation, user prompts, and sending invocation requests.

methods.name: currentKey
methods.description: Returns the expected current deep link key.

methods.name: currentCanvasKey
methods.description: Returns the ephemeral key used for unattended deep links from Canvas.

methods.name: expectedKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the stored deep link key from UserDefaults.

methods.name: generateRandomKey
methods.description: Generates a cryptographically secure random key for deep links.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog to the user and returns their response.

methods.name: presentAlert
methods.description: Displays an informational alert to the user.
